defect_original: validate_pair_manifest discarded manifest-level invalid_reasons and echoed claim_level unchanged, so pair_valid=False could still surface PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE.
remediation: Manifest-level invalid_reasons are propagated into validator output before the identity checks; when full validity is false the claim is downgraded to UNPAIRED_CAPTURE and never remains PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE.
